key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥5%) were nausea (15% vs 12% placebo), diarrhea (12% vs 9%), pyrexia, nasopharyngitis, bronchitis (9% vs 5%), insomnia, pain in extremity, depression, migraine, and pharyngitis. Serious concerns included more deaths with BENLYSTA than placebo (14 deaths out of 2133 patients), serious and sometimes fatal infections, and infusion/hypersensitivity reactions (infusion-associated AEs in 17% BENLYSTA vs 15% placebo).
